explanation: Erdős #302: estimate f(N), the largest A ⊆ [N] with no distinct a, b, c having 1/a = 1/b + 1/c. It is posed as lim f(N)/N = answer, which implicitly asserts that the limit exists (unknown); this is acceptable for a question-value statement. The site gives (5/8 + o(1))N ≤ f(N) ≤ (9/10 + o(1))N. The statement is faithful and open.
